major_event: Phemex announced its Earn Crypto program for 18 January 2021 with Flexible and Fixed Savings; current 2026 materials continue to document active Savings products and governing Earn terms

duplicate_check.notes: Repository code search found no canonical Phemex/Phemex Savings platform before staging. Hardened scanner must still confirm canonical-name, alias and phemex.com domain clearance before promotion.

notes: Product-scoped candidate for Phemex Savings rather than the full exchange or every Phemex Earn product. First-party launch material establishes a 2021-01-18 service start for Flexible and Fixed Savings. Current Earn terms state subscribed Earn Assets may be commingled with Phemex and affiliate assets, may be used for operating purposes including loans and on-chain staking, and in exceptional circumstances some or all Earn Assets may not be returned. Current product availability varies by asset and period, so canonical review must not convert promotional safety language from older announcements into a universal custody, segregation, principal or solvency guarantee.

duplicate_check.notes: Repository code search found no canonical WhiteBIT/WhiteBIT Crypto Lending platform before staging. Hardened scanner must still confirm canonical-name, alias and whitebit.com domain clearance before promotion.

notes: Product-scoped exchange-lending candidate. The 2022 WhiteBIT Earn announcement explicitly says SMART Staking was renamed Crypto Lending and that the change did not affect assets. Current first-party terms define Crypto Lending as lending digital assets to WhiteBIT, acknowledge substantial digital-asset and investment risks, and distinguish third-party proposals that may also appear in the section. 2026 first-party notices confirm active fixed and flexible plans. Canonical review should preserve the predecessor-name relationship without assuming SMART Staking and every later Crypto Lending feature had identical legal or operational terms across the full history.
